canonical_name: Donnelly-Li theorem (pure point spectrum under curvature tending to minus infinity)
canonical_statement: Provisional source-faithful scope: a complete noncompact Riemannian manifold whose sectional curvatures tend to minus infinity at infinity has pure point (discrete) spectrum for its Laplace-Beltrami operator.
